comment: AccuRIG CC_Base skeleton on exemplar_accurig_bakeoff.fbx. Poses use WORLD-axis rotations (world_axis: side=X, forward=Y, up=Z; character faces -Y) — local-euler axes on this FBX's bone rolls proved unpredictable (smeared several poses), the world-axis quaternion form is rig-convention-independent. Right-hand rule signs. No clips: the FBX carries only T-pose actions; animation goes through the Unity path.
